translation.title: Ketoprofen Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner from the medicated surface and apply the patch to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: hypersensitivity or photosensitivity to this medicine; aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs); people who are hypersensitive to ingredients that can cause cross-hypersensitivity reactions (tiaprofenic acid, fenofibrate, bezafibrate, ciprofibrate, oxybenzone); women who are 6 months or more pregnant; children under 15 years of age; the eyes; mucous membranes; athlete’s foot; ringworm. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people with bronchial asthma; pregnant or breastfeeding women; damaged skin or mucous membranes; use on areas of eczema or rash. While using this medicine and for 2 weeks after use, avoid outdoor activity regardless of the weather, and when you go out cover the application site with clothing, sunglasses, a hat or sunscreen so that it is not exposed to ultraviolet light. Do not use an occlusive dressing. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: shock (rarely); anaphylactoid symptoms (hypersensitivity-like symptoms such as urticaria, difficulty breathing and facial swelling); asthma attacks (dry rales (a bubbling sound), wheezing, difficulty breathing); occasional redness (congestion and reddening); rash; itching; blisters; erosion; contact dermatitis such as irritation and swelling; dry skin and pigmentation. Store at room temperature, protected from light. Keep out of reach of children.
